headerDisplay:
### Poer Smart Thermostat Configuration

To retrieve your API key:
1. Open the **Poer Smart** mobile app.
2. Navigate to **Settings** → **Third-Party Platform** → **Home Assistant**.
3. Generate or copy your API key (begins with `eu` or `cn`).

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: Custom name for the platform plugin.

apiKey.title: Poer API Key
apiKey.description: Your API key from the Poer Smart mobile app (begins with 'cn' or 'eu').

refreshInterval.title: Polling Interval (Seconds)
refreshInterval.description: How frequently to query Poer Cloud for temperature and state updates (default: 30s).

showEcoSwitch.title: Expose Eco Mode Switch
showEcoSwitch.description: Expose an Eco Mode switch in Apple Home to easily switch between normal Heating and Eco / Away temperature.

debug.title: Enable Debug Logging
debug.description: Show verbose API request and response details in the Homebridge log.
